name: programming_groups
description: A company-owned group of screens that share one program, spanning the whole company or a fixed set of branches.
lifecycle: Created with its program; renames and span changes bump the version. Deleted at runtime, with its program and span rows, only when it has no member screens.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the group; immutable (tenant key).
Display name, trimmed, 1 to 80 characters, unique in the company ignoring case.
True when the group spans every branch of the company; otherwise programming_group_branches lists its span.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A group belongs to an existing company.
Names are trimmed and not empty.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX programming_groups_company_id_id_key ON public.programming_groups USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX programming_groups_company_name_unique ON public.programming_groups USING btree (company_id, lower((name)::text))
constraints.Purpose: Group names are unique in a company, ignoring case.
